_meta.description: Label normalization mapping for the Resume Classification Model. Maps dataset-specific category names to the five canonical target categories. Only verified mappings are listed here — do NOT add a mapping unless the relationship is clearly justified.
_meta.instructions: The 'dataset_label' field is the exact string as it appears in your dataset's category column. The 'canonical' field is the target category. The 'justification' field must explain why the mapping is valid. If a dataset label does not map cleanly to any target category, add it to 'unmapped_labels' with a note.
